question: Should OpenClaw permanently bundle and own this Twilio-backed RCS channel, or should it ship as an external ClawHub code plugin with only any necessary generic plugin API proposed separately?
rationale: Current plugin distribution and VISION.md favor external ownership, while the contributor argues that carrier-adjacent RCS should share the bundled tier of SMS; automation cannot choose that long-term product, security, dependency, and support commitment.

options.title: External ClawHub plugin
options.body: Publish RCS as a code plugin and submit only a narrowly justified generic webhook API enhancement to core if the external implementation proves it is necessary.

options.title: Sponsor bundled channel
options.body: Accept permanent core ownership only after the findings, compatibility review, carrier-level proof, exact-head dependency approval, and merge conflicts are resolved.

options.title: Pause for demand
options.body: Leave the implementation open but unmerged until maintainers have stronger demand or ownership capacity for a bundled commercial-service channel.

recommendation.title: External ClawHub plugin
recommendation.body: Publish RCS as a code plugin and submit only a narrowly justified generic webhook API enhancement to core if the external implementation proves it is necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged bundled Twilio SMS implementation is the closest product precedent and was introduced by this person.
